title: The Note That Watched Everyone
description:
Amaka: 'The search field was bad. The notes feature was worse. The Griot posted something to the notes board and walked away. For the next six hours, every analyst who opened that dashboard executed The Griot's code in their own browser — without clicking anything, without a link, without being tricked. The payload just sat there in the database and fired automatically.'

Tunde: 'This is a different class of problem from the previous task, even though the mechanism on the wire looks similar. The persistence — the fact it lives in storage and fires on every render — is what makes it worse, and it is what changes the vulnerability class. Confirm the injection point in the lab.'

In the pentest finding (task 9) you will be asked which of the two field-class vulnerabilities you'd write up first, and why. Take notes on the difference in blast radius.

Reference: OWASP Top 10 2021 A03 Injection; OWASP XSS Prevention Cheat Sheet — Stored XSS section; CWE-79 (Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation) — variant: Stored.
